sourceBasis.note: The school describes about 60% correct on past papers as a guide; official question point weights are not available in the supplied source set.

FY25-A.partRule: For a parent question with multiple objectively scorable parts, parent credit is correctParts/partCount.
FY25-A.writtenRule: Written/diagram items use the verified rubric to award a 0..1 parent fraction; no official partial-credit claim is made.

promotionRule: An exam enters scored runtime only after every visible question in that exam is APP_DERIVED_VERIFIED and its rubric/part structure is validated.
